scope: G4c round 3: the THRESHOLD conjecture, plus a construction-robustness control. Written after rounds 1 and 2 came back 10/10 and before any d = 5 measurement or any change of observer geometry.

the_observation_that_prompted_this.why_this_is_not_evidence: Three points determine a quadratic exactly. The fit has zero residual because it has zero degrees of freedom, not because it is right. Reporting it as a finding would be reporting an interpolation as a law. It becomes evidence only out of sample, which is what P11 is for.
the_observation_that_prompted_this.how_it_differs_from_the_regime_law: The regime law is a statement about ranks and is construction-independent by nature. A threshold is a statement about WHERE a rank transition happens, and could easily depend on how observers and targets are placed. That is the point of P12.

predictions.target: d = 5, R = 7 (= d + 2), first rigid n
predictions.falsified_if: the threshold is any other integer, or is not reached in the scan
predictions.basis: a three-point quadratic interpolation with no derivation behind it. This is the weakest prediction anywhere in the G4c series and is written down mainly so that a miss is on the record rather than quietly dropped. A miss falsifies the threshold FORMULA and says nothing about the regime law.

predictions.target: d = 3, R = 5, observer shell drawn from a different seed
predictions.falsified_if: a different observer shell moves the threshold
predictions.basis: control. If the threshold moves when only the observer placement changes, then P11 was fitting an artifact of one arbitrary construction and the whole threshold line should be reported as construction-dependent. The regime verdicts (rank constant / growing / equal to gauge) would be unaffected either way.

predictions.claim: nullity == 15 == gauge d(d+1)/2 once rigid; and d = 5, R = 6 is saturated at nullity = d*R + gauge = 30 + 15 = 45, constant in n
predictions.basis: the regime law and the counting law at a fourth dimension. Unlike P11 these follow from the stated mechanism rather than from a curve fit.

note_on_scope: Rounds 1 and 2 are not amended. A perfect scorecard across all three rounds still leaves G4c [MEASURED] -- infinitesimal rigidity in the exact model -- and does not touch global uniqueness, noisy D, or D harvested through the instrument.
